user.title: Connect your Elsner P03/3 weather station
user.description: How is the weather station connected to Home Assistant?

menu_options.rtu: Modbus RTU (RS-485 adapter on this machine)

tcp.title: Modbus TCP
tcp.description: The station is tested as soon as you press Submit. If it cannot be reached, your values stay filled in so you can correct them and try again.

data_description.name: Name of the device in Home Assistant.
data_description.host: IP address or host name of the Modbus TCP gateway the station is wired to.
data_description.rtu_over_tcp: Enable for a transparent RS-485 to Ethernet converter that forwards raw RTU frames. Leave off for a real Modbus TCP gateway.
data_description.slave: Set with the address DIP switches on the station. Factory default (all switches off) is 1.
data_description.has_gps: Adds sun position, coordinates and GPS time.
data_description.area_id: Room or zone to put the weather station in. You can change this later on the device page.
